component.name: Easy-Github-Uploader
component.summary: Upload complete project folders to GitHub with a simple Qt6 interface

description.p: Easy-Github-Uploader is a Linux desktop application that lets you publish your project files to an existing GitHub repository without manually running Git commands. Sign in using your browser, paste a repository URL, choose or drag and drop a folder, and confirm the upload.

The app supports the first upload to an empty repository and replacement of existing files while preserving Git history. It previews changes, excludes common generated and sensitive files, and never changes the original local project folder.
Added the official EGU application icon to the Qt6 window, Linux desktop launcher, and AppStream metadata.
Added a persistent version and author footer, with a clickable GitHub profile link.
Added the GPL-3.0-only license and AppStream application metadata.
Fixed uploads to empty GitHub repositories and switched the interface to English.
